leads.summary: Coordinate this PR's picker cache and source assertion with open PR #10520
leads.consequence: The two diverged PRs both change the picker and the same test. A three-way merge using #10520's own merge base produces conflict markers in the QML property block and test. Resolving QML by keeping both the wallpaper-preview properties and filteredPositions makes the picker functionality coexist, but this PR's retained thumbnailPath source regex rejects #10520's intended displayPath image source, so the combined shell test exits 1. Resolving the QML hunk by taking only #10520's side instead discards this PR's filteredPositions declaration and on-change rebuild handlers. Merge coordination must retain both sets of properties and update the source assertion to the final image-source expression.

leads.summary: The new source-level test does not catch a wrong argument to the cache rebuild
leads.consequence: The QML assertion checks that two on-change handlers and delegate expressions are present, but not what rebuildFilteredPositions passes into the tested model helper. A plausible copy/paste typo in ImagePicker.qml:108, passing imageRows rather than imageArray, leaves the changed image-picker test green yet builds [] for any nonempty IPC rows string. Delegates then read undefined, matched becomes false and nearby/visible are false, so the picker card contains no selectable slides even with images loaded. Add a QML integration assertion or test that loads rows then changes the filter and verifies the delegates, or at minimum assert the helper's actual imageArray/filterText argument wiring.

## Automated AI review

> **Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

**Outcome:** No defects found.

<details><summary>Verified</summary>

- Delegate `matched`, `selected`, `nearby` and `visible`, plus `x`, `z` and `relativeIndex` for visible slides, match the base for every in-range selection in a model sweep (246,680 picker states) and in a stubbed QML run of 21 picker steps (filtering, moves, list reloads with a filter set, theme-mode add/remove), with no QML warnings.
- `filteredPositions` is already current when the Repeater creates delegates (0 stale of 187 creations); a `Qt.callLater` mutant and a mutant without `onImageArrayChanged` are both detected by the same harness.
- No other caller of the removed `filteredPosition` or the changed `selectedFilteredPosition` exists in the tree.
- The 5 new assertions (7 checks) each fail on the base code and pass at the head; `overlay-window-test.sh`, `qml-text-format-test.sh` and `plugins-test.sh` pass on both.
- Filtered keystroke cost becomes linear (stubbed QML, no rendering, median of 8 keystrokes):

| Slides | Base | Head |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | 84 ms | 1 ms |
| 800 | 1,516 ms | 3 ms |
| 1,600 | 6,244 ms | 7 ms |
</details>

<details><summary>Optional notes</summary>

- **Optional test improvement:** the new source assertion checks the handler and delegate lines but not the arguments in `rebuildFilteredPositions()`. A mutant passing `imageRows` instead of `imageArray` leaves every slide unmatched and invisible, yet the whole test file still passes. Extending the regex to `ImagePickerModel\.filteredPositions\(imageArray, filterText\)` would catch it.
</details>
